textRuns.value: Round 4 added Customers, Reviews and Web Traffic, fixed an ALLSELECTED bug in Seasonality Index, an ambiguous relationship path through Reviews, and a backwards fromColumn/toColumn direction on 3 relationships. Round 5 merged the two Customer pages into one, added Promotions, swapped 2 Executive Overview KPIs for Phase 2 ones, and stretched detail-row charts to the full remaining page height instead of leaving the table's shorter height as dead space below them. Round 6 added a custom colour theme and chart variety (donut, combo). Round 7 fixed an unexplained promo-channel blank bar and inconsistent chart captions. Round 8 added a real SKU-level overstock exception table using a confirmed visual-level filter. Round 9 moved Site Traffic back onto the Customers and Satisfaction page without changing any page's canvas size. See README.md for the full log.
